algorithm: Compute and store the same stable sigmoid and correction-only score for all eight lane-owned experts.
For each of ten positions, each lane selects its best remaining local expert, then the wave applies the existing stable higher-score/lower-ID reduction.
Lane zero writes the identical selected order, gathers the uncorrected probability, sums the ten probabilities in the retained position order, normalizes, and applies routed scale.
